drhp.business: Our Company was originally formed as a partnership firm under the name ‘M/s Octagon Industries’ (“Partnership Firm”) pursuant to a deed of partnership dated April 30, 2021, under the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (“Partnership Act”). Antala Industries Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing, processing, printing, laminating and supplying a comprehensive range of industrial and commercial packaging products. The Company specializes in the manufacture of BOPP bags, BOPP Printing Roll, BOPP lamination Roll, PP woven bags, PP Woven Fabrics Roll.
drhp.one_liner: Our Company’s strengths and its ability to successfully implement its business strategies may be affected by various factors that have an influence on its operations, or on the industry segment in which our Company operates, which may have been disclosed in “Risk Factors” on page 19 of this Red Herring Prospectus.

risks: A substantial portion of our revenue is generated from our Top 10 customers.

Our reliance on a concentrated customer base, coupled with the nature of the commoditised and highly price-sensitive market in which we operate, subjects us to risks associated with customer concentration, demand cyclicality, pricing volatility, and fluctuations in purchasing patterns.

The loss of any significant customer, a reduction in order volumes, inability to maintain existing customer Risks Internal Risks External Risks relationships, or adverse changes in market conditions could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows.

We derive a substantial portion of our revenues from our Top 10 customers, and any reduction in demand from such customers, loss of key customer relationships, adverse changes in procurement patterns, or increased pricing pressures may materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows.
Our business is exposed to customer concentration risk, and our financial performance is significantly dependent on the continued demand from, and business relationships with, such customers.
Any reduction in purchase volumes, consolidation among customers, shift in sourcing strategies, or inability to retain existing customers could adversely affect our revenues and profitability.
The products manufactured by industry participants are generally perceived as being largely substitutable, with limited product differentiation.
Consequently, purchasing decisions are often driven primarily by price competitiveness, product quality, delivery timelines, production capacity, credit terms and service reliability.

overview.business_overview:
Our Company was originally formed as a partnership firm under the name ‘M/s Octagon Industries’ (“Partnership Firm”) pursuant to a deed of partnership dated April 30, 2021, under the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (“Partnership Act”). The partnership firm was thereafter converted from ‘M/s Octagon Industries’ into Public Limited Company under Section 366 Part I of Chapter XXI of the Companies Act, 2013, as ‘Antala Industries Limited’ under the erstwhile Companies Act, 2013, pursuant to a certificate of incorporation dated August 05, 2024, issued by the Registrar of Companies, Central Registration Centre. The Corporate Identification Number of the Company is U22208GJ2024PLC154065.

Antala Industries Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing, processing, printing, laminating and supplying a comprehensive range of industrial and commercial packaging products. The Company specializes in the manufacture of BOPP bags, BOPP Printing Roll, BOPP lamination Roll, PP woven bags, PP Woven Fabrics Roll.

The Company provides customized packaging solutions to customers operating across various sectors such as food processing, fertilizers, chemicals, cement, seeds, etc. Its packaging products are designed to provide strength, durability, moisture resistance, enhanced shelf appeal and high-quality printability, enabling customers to effectively package, transport and market their products.

The Company operates an integrated manufacturing facility located at Rajkot, Gujarat, equipped with extrusion, coating and lamination, rotogravure printing, roll-to-roll multi-colour printing, stitching and finishing infrastructure. The integrated nature of its operations enables the Company to undertake the process in-house, beginning from printing, lamination, cutting, stitching, finishing and packaging of the final product. This integrated manufacturing setup allows the Company to maintain quality standards, optimize production efficiencies and deliver customized packaging solutions in a timely manner.

The Company possesses capabilities in multicolour rotogravure and flexographic printing, enabling it to offer visually appealing and brand-focused packaging solutions tailored to customer specifications. Its design and product development capabilities assist customers in enhancing product visibility and brand recognition through innovative packaging formats and customized printing solutions.

The Company places significant emphasis on quality control and customer satisfaction and undertakes manufacturing processes in accordance with established quality management practices. The Company also maintains high standards of product quality, operational efficiency and customer service through continuous process improvements and adherence to quality assurance systems. Further, Our Company also holds certifications such as ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 22000:2018 and ISO 45001:2018 reflecting Quality Management System, driven by our commitment to deliver work that meets project-specific standards and specifications for materials, workmanship and timelines. Our Company, under the management of Promoters having nearly three decades of experience in the packaging industry, is engaged in the manufacturing of woven packaging products and BOPP products for various industrial and commercial applications. Over the years, the promoters have gained extensive experience in manufacturing operations, product development, customer relationship management and business expansion. Their understanding of market trends and customer requirements has helped the Company continuously improve its product offerings and strengthen its position in the packaging industry.

The promoters have been actively involved in every stage of the Company's growth journey, including setting up manufacturing facilities, expanding production capacities, adopting modern technologies and developing long-term relationships with customers across various industries. Their focus on quality, innovation and customer satisfaction has enabled the Company to establish a reputation for delivering reliable and customized packaging solutions. For further details on Promoters & Management, kindly refer to page number 171 and 156 respectively.
